docs.title: 👯 About Me
docs.text:
I am a Software Engineer graduated from the University of Technology – Baghdad (2009).

My journey in web development started in 2006 during high school. Since then I have been passionate about building websites and learning new technologies.

There is a saying:

If you want to learn something, teach it.

Because of that, I started publishing web development tutorials on YouTube to help others learn programming for free.
